status_boundary: Machine readiness is not maintainer confirmation, expert scoring, professional approval, selection or implementation authorization.

deterministic_validation.evidence: The official deterministic validator completed successfully on the current package bytes.

spatial_review.evidence: Topology and metric recalculation passed; three provisional key-area findings remain explicitly disclosed and non-blocking.

visual_review.evidence: Offline visual packaging, required sections and metric consistency completed successfully.

professional_review.evidence: Standards, design-depth, geometry, metrics, sources and assumptions completed the professional evidence review.

checks.message: Canonical author and submission directory are both dw-zhu-si; the package uses the current formal bilingual contract.
Chinese and English Markdown, offline HTML, visual pages, A0/A3 PDFs and five required text-bearing figures are present and paired in the manifest.
Required files, hashes, counts, references, package size, paths and formal-stage constraints pass the official deterministic validator.
Geometry and metric recalculation pass. The site and three key-area polygons remain explicitly provisional and are not official redlines or precise-area evidence.
Static visual packaging, required sections and metrics pass; pages contain no remote media, executable scripts, tracking, forms or iframes.
Standards, design-depth obligations, geometry, metrics, sources, assumptions and explicit data gaps are cross-linked.
No provisional geometry, conceptual land-use role, relationship line or prototype envelope is represented as statutory, surveyed or approved.
Every public-facing AI scenario retains a named human decision route, non-digital fallback, appeal, stop rule and retirement condition.
Ten project contracts identify owner type, operator, CAPEX/OPEX category, minimum gate, outcome KPI, expiry and restoration obligation.
Real photographs, relational analysis and AI concept images are separated; photo, OpenStreetMap and AI labels retain their required attribution and usage boundaries.
The proposal claims no access to real personal, access-control, payment or sensor data and requires separate legal, security, procurement and operational approval for any future connection.
The public package contains the design, mandatory evidence, licences and risk statements; optional production logs, research corpora, internal reviews and local execution paths are excluded.

The bilingual supplement separates OpenStreetMap context, provisional action zones, candidate sections, field tasks and six independent professional gates without upgrading them to official, surveyed or approved status.
